subject: Operations
title: Ethical Sourcing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Ethical Sourcing.

hook.text: A chocolate bar linked to child labor. The brand knew nothing—its supplier's supplier used forced labor.

buildup.text: Ethical sourcing means ensuring suppliers meet standards for labor rights, safety, fair wages, and no corruption.

discovery.text: Audits, certifications, and supplier codes of conduct are standard tools for monitoring ethical compliance.

twist.text: Audits only catch what's visible. Deep-tier violations hide behind layers of subcontracting and opacity.

climax.text: Blockchain traceability now lets consumers scan a product and see its ethical journey from farm to shelf.

punchline.text: Know your suppliers' suppliers. Ethics go deep.

quiz.question: Why are ethical sourcing audits limited?
